eligibility: Hold a PhD by thesis, or a degree, diploma or certificate recognised as equivalent under European Union directives or a bilateral agreement

The PhD was obtained no longer than 3 years before 1 October of the year in which the fellowship starts, or will be obtained by 15 September of that year at the latest, in which case the public defence date must be notified to the FWO by 1 July of that year
Have a supervisor at a Flemish host institution
Have not previously benefited from a junior postdoctoral fellowship, not even partially
May apply a maximum of two times for the same fellowship; from the 2027 call a second application is only possible if the first ranked in the top 50% of the preselection
Agree to the FWO Research Integrity Clause
existing.eligibility_summary: Researchers with a PhD thesis, or an equivalent recognised degree, obtained no more than three years before 1 October of the fellowship start year, who need a supervisor at a Flemish host institution and have not held this fellowship before.
benefits: Gross monthly salary of EUR 5,616.81 for a researcher with four years of seniority (index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026)
Fixed operating allowance or bench fee of EUR 4,000 to EUR 10,000 per year
coverage: Gross monthly salary of EUR 5,616.81 for a researcher with four years of seniority (index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026)
Fixed operating allowance or bench fee of EUR 4,000 to EUR 10,000 per year
requirements: A supervisor at a Flemish host institution who will submit a letter of recommendation
Agreement to the FWO Research Integrity Clause
Application addressed to the FWO expert panel that best matches the project scope
documents: Mandatory letter of recommendation from the supervisor, following the FWO guidelines
Online application form submitted through the FWO e-portal
application_method: Secure a supervisor at a Flemish host institution before submitting
Submit the application via the FWO online application portal at fwoweb.fwo.be, addressed to an FWO expert panel
Ensure the supervisor's letter of recommendation is submitted, as it is a mandatory component and an evaluation criterion
existing.selection_notes: Applications are assessed in two rounds: online preselection meetings from 18 to 25 March 2027, then interviews between 14 April and 5 May 2027 for candidates invited on 26 March 2027. The FWO board makes the final decision on the basis of the expert panels' proposals, and results are announced on 13 May 2027.
existing.best_fit: Researchers who obtained their doctorate between October 2024 and September 2027 and want a three-year salaried research career at a university or research institute in Flanders.
existing.notes:
From the 2027 call a supervisor may support a maximum of five applications per call for junior and senior fellowships combined. Certain postdoctoral fellowships funded in association with Plantentuin Meise, VITO, WL and KBS carry an additional special bench fee.
Funding period: per month (gross salary, index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026), plus an operating allowance of EUR 4,000-10,000 per year
existing.duration: 3 years, no extension possible; start on 1 October or 1 November 2027
existing.application_period: Call open from 17 September 2026; applications accepted until 5pm on 16 November 2026
